name: PP-OCR (accurate recognition)
author: Oxelis
description: Model pack for the accurate OCR engine: PP-OCRv5 detector + PP-OCRv6 small recognizer (Apache-2.0) and ONNX Runtime (MIT). Without it the app uses Windows OCR. Models are not in the repository: run tools/fetch-ocr-assets.py or install from the plugin manager.

credits.name: onnxocr (ONNX conversion of the PaddleOCR models, the source of the files)
